# Demo Release Governance: draft course outline

Synthetic course material authored for this repository; no real institution or learners.

## Learning objective
Explain the approval, withdrawal and rollback rules for this fictional course.

## Fictional course rules
A release needs approved source permissions, evaluation evidence and professor approval before publication. Withdrawal makes a release unavailable for new student use. Rollback is an explicit choice of a previously approved eligible release, followed by the application's checks.

## Review status
The instructor has not completed source review for this course. These notes must remain pending and must not enter student retrieval until approved.
